title: Google’s AI Pro plan is a Black Friday steal at $100 a year
content_html:
Published Nov 23, 2026, 3:45 AM EST

I've been writing about Android since 2011, with a focus on device reviews, Samsung and Google Pixel hardware, Google’s apps and services, and Gemini AI. Throughout my writing career, I've reviewed several Android phones and attended major consumer tech events like MWC and IFA.

Carrying both a Samsung or Pixel flagship and an iPhone as daily drivers gives me deep insight into how Android works and how it compares to iOS. I also closely follow Google’s AI efforts, exploring how Gemini fits into Android and the wider Google ecosystem.

I have been writing for Android Police since 2021, covering news, how-tos, and features. You can find my previous work on Neowin, AndroidBeat, Times of India, iPhoneHacks, MySmartPrice, and MakeUseOf.

When not working, I tend to mindlessly scroll through X, play with new AI models, or go on long road trips. You can reach out to me on X or drop me an email at rajesh@androidpolice.com.

For Black Friday, Google is slashing the price of its AI Plus and AI Pro plans by up to 50% annually for its existing subscribers. That makes an already feature-packed subscription even better value, especially if you use Google’s cloud storage and bundled services.

Google's AI Pro plan already offers incredible value for money. For $20 per month, it provides access to up to 5 TB of storage that you can share with your family, alongside access to several premium Google subscriptions like YouTube Premium Lite, Google Health Premium, and Google Home Premium Standard. Plus, you get priority support, access to the latest AI models, and more.

If you pay yearly, the price of Google's AI Pro subscription drops to $200, further sweetening the deal. But for Black Friday, Google is running an offer for its existing AI Pro subscribers, where they can subscribe to the annual plan for only $100. That's 50% off its regular price.

The discount comes as Google’s Gemini 4 family — Carbon, Hydrogen, Neon, and Argon — puts the company back in the AI race, with coding capabilities that rival the latest models from Anthropic and OpenAI. With the AI Pro plan, you get four times the standard usage limit for Neon.

If you already use Gemini for coding and other everyday tasks, the annual offer is even more tempting, bringing the cost down to just over $8 a month.

For comparison, rival plans from ChatGPT and Claude cost $20 and don't offer anywhere near the same perks as that of Google’s AI Pro plan. So, the discounted $99 yearly price makes it a no-brainer.

A smaller price for lighter users

If you're not a heavy Gemini user and currently using Google and currently paying for Google's AI Plus plan, it is also available with a 50% discount. This plan normally costs $7.99 a month in the US and is also part of the Black Friday promotion, with eligible existing subscribers getting up to 50% off. The final discount depends on your current subscription, so check your Google One account for the offer available to you.

For that price, you get access to Gemini 4 Hydrogen with twice the free tier’s usage limits, Deep Research, and more access to Gemini Notebook and image, music, and video generation tools. Google also bundles 400 GB of storage across Gmail, Drive, and Photos, which you can share with up to five family members.

The offer runs through 26th November, so you have a few days to renew your subscription. If you already have AI Plus or AI Pro at a discounted rate or through a free promotion, such as a Pixel purchase offer, taking up this Black Friday deal will replace your existing offer.
